import numpy as np
from xarray import Variable
from xarray.coding.variables import UnsignedIntegerCoder

# pydap case: unsigned bytes with _Unsigned='false' -> should become signed
v = Variable(('test',), np.array([128, 255, 0, 1, 2, 127], dtype='u1'),
             {'_Unsigned': 'false'}, {})
out = UnsignedIntegerCoder().decode(v, name='test')
print('u1 + _Unsigned=false ->', out.dtype, out.values)
assert out.dtype == np.int8
assert list(out.values) == [-128, -1, 0, 1, 2, 127]

# fill value conversion
v2 = Variable(('t',), np.array([200, 1], dtype='u1'), {'_Unsigned': 'false', '_FillValue': 200}, {})
out2 = UnsignedIntegerCoder().decode(v2, name='t')
print('fill:', out2.attrs['_FillValue'], out2.values)
assert out2.attrs['_FillValue'] == -56

# regression: original cases still work
v3 = Variable(('t',), np.array([-128, -1, 127], dtype='i1'), {'_Unsigned': 'true'}, {})
out3 = UnsignedIntegerCoder().decode(v3, name='t')
assert out3.dtype == np.uint8 and list(out3.values) == [128, 255, 127]
v4 = Variable(('t',), np.array([1.0, 2.0]), {'_Unsigned': 'true'}, {})
import warnings
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
    warnings.simplefilter('always')
    UnsignedIntegerCoder().decode(v4, name='t')

# unsigned with _Unsigned='true' -> unchanged, no warning
v5 = Variable(('t',), np.array([1, 2], dtype='u1'), {'_Unsigned': 'true'}, {})
out5 = UnsignedIntegerCoder().decode(v5, name='t')
assert out5.dtype == np.uint8
print('all checks passed')
"
